# Straand Hotel

> Straand Hotel is a historic, family-run hotel at Kviteseidvegen 1698, 3853 Vrådal, Telemark, Norway, on Lake Nisser. Founded 1864 as a coaching inn and run today by the fifth generation (Katrine and Lars Arne Straand). 125 rooms, restaurant and bars, heated indoor pool and sauna, a conference hall for 400, and the 1909 vintage boat MS Fram.

Contact: +47 35 06 90 00 (reception open 24 hours), straand@straand.no. Booking: https://be.synxis.com/?Hotel=7080. Check-in From 3 pm (4 pm June–September); check-out Before 11 am. Free parking (approx. 100 spaces) and EV charging. Legal entity: STRAAND HOTEL AS, org. no. 945 805 013. Each English page has a Norwegian (nb) twin.

## About
For us, hospitality is more than a tradition. It is an inheritance passed down through five generations. Since 1864 we have welcomed guests to Vrådal, and we want you to feel as at home here as we do.

For oss er gjestfrihet mer enn en tradisjon. Det er en arv som har gått i fem generasjoner. Siden 1864 har vi ønsket gjester velkommen til Vrådal, og vi vil at du skal føle deg like hjemme hos oss som vi gjør.

## Rooms
### Historic rooms / Historiske rom
Single and double rooms in the old wing, with log walls and traditional furniture. TV, desk and shower room.
Enkelt- og dobbeltrom i gamledelen, med tømmervegger og tradisjonsmøbler. TV, skrivebord og bad med dusj.

### Standard double / Standard dobbeltrom
Two singles or a double bed, desk, armchair or sofa and TV. Bathroom with shower or bath.
To enkeltsenger eller dobbeltseng, skrivebord, lenestol eller sofa og TV. Bad med dusj eller badekar.

### Family room / Familierom
Double bed and a double sofa bed, desk and TV. Shower room.
Dobbeltseng og dobbel sovesofa, skrivebord og TV. Bad med dusj.

### Demi-suite / Demi-suite
Bedroom on the first floor, living room with sofa bed and balcony on the second. Coffee machine and phone.
Soverom i første etasje, stue med sovesofa og balkong i andre. Kaffemaskin og telefon.

### Accessible room / Tilgjengelig rom
Wide doors, a large bathroom and room for a wheelchair. Sofa bed for a companion. We have two.
Brede dører, stort bad og plass til rullestol. Sovesofa til ledsager. Vi har to slike rom.

### Single room / Enkeltrom
Bed, desk and TV. Shower room. Travelling alone suits Straand too.
Seng, skrivebord og TV. Bad med dusj. Du bor godt alene på Straand også.

## Eat & drink
### The restaurant
Breakfast and dinner overlooking Lake Nisser. Evening buffet in summer, otherwise adapted to the number of guests.

### The terrace
Lunch, coffee and ice cream in the sun. One of the hotel's favourite spots on a fine day.

### Fram Bar
Coffee, cocktails and light dishes. The meeting place before and after the day's adventures.

### The beach bar
Our own beach club on Lake Nisser, with swimming, SUP, kayaks and simple summer food.

### The wine cellar
A historic cellar for private dinners, wine tastings and small parties.

### MS Fram
The 1909 vintage boat sails through the Småstraum and Storstraum locks, with refreshments on board.

## Seasons
### Winter
Ski slopes, forest trails, fireside evenings, the pool and sauna, and play for the children.

### Spring
The golf course on Fossøy opens, the bikes come out and the first motorcycles find their way to Vrådal.

### Summer
The jetty, the beach club, MS Fram and long evenings on the terrace. Straand is made for families.

### Autumn
Venelifjellet in autumn colours, berries and mushrooms in the forest, game on the menu and the fire lit at night.

## History
- 1864: Olav and Kari buy Upper and Lower Straand and take over Vrådal's coaching station. Kari becomes known for her food, and the coffee is almost famous.
- 1902: Their son Johan and his wife Sigrid take over. Holiday guests start arriving in earnest, first in summer.
- 1924: The Swiss-style hotel burns down. By Christmas the following year a new hotel in storehouse style is ready, and its log walls still stand.
- 1948: The third generation, Sigmund and Jorunn, take over and steer the hotel into the age of mass tourism.
- 1973: Johan Straand buys the hotel from his mother. Extensions in the 70s and 80s make Straand one of Telemark's largest hotels.
- 2019: Lars Arne and Katrine move home to Vrådal and take over as the fifth generation.

## Meetings & celebrations
The Vrådal Hall is about 660 m² and seats 400 in one room. It can be divided, and there are several smaller rooms and breakout rooms. A 4.5-metre drive-in door makes set-up easy.
Weddings, anniversaries, confirmations or company parties: we have no standard package, we put it together with you. A ceremony in the apple orchard, a vintage car to the church or a trip on MS Fram for 90 guests.
All meeting rooms have a PA system, screen and flip chart. Breakout rooms have a screen and flip chart. Wifi throughout the hotel.
Activities: Guided mountain hike, Canoe trip, Trail biking, Rock climbing, Snowshoe and ski trips, Ski instruction, Team-building competitions

## Events
- 30 Oct – 1 Nov: The Straand Festival. The annual music and dance festival, with Norwegian dance music on several stages all weekend.
- Six weekends before Christmas: Christmas parties. Home-made Christmas food in the historic lounges, with a show and entertainment. Rooms are booked separately.

## Motorcycling (HUBRiding)
Telemark has some of Norway's best roads to ride: hairpins, steep climbs and routes between fjord and mountain. With HUBRiding you stay at Straand, unpack once and ride a new route every day.
HUBRiding was created here at Straand, with BikerDudes and our colleagues in De Historiske. The routes are laid out by local riders, and the concept now also exists for cars and bicycles.
Services: Free parking for motorcycles and cars; Vehicle washing; Drying room for riding gear; Access to tools and equipment; Packed lunch and coffee for the day's ride; The roof terrace after the ride
Routes: https://hubriding.no/straand/
Film: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JksEW6dPVmw
- 1 May: Cars, Bikes & Coffee. Season opening on the roof terrace with coffee, lunch and the sound of engines.
- Second weekend in May: Riding refresher. Rider training on Fyresdal airfield.
- 13–15 August 2027: Triumph Nordic Treff. A weekend of riding and community, with Triumph Motorcycles Nordic.
- Third weekend in September: Straandtreffet. The highlight of the year for motorcyclists and the season finale in Telemark.

## FAQ
### Booking & rates
**How do I book a room?**
Choose your dates and number of guests in the booking bar at the top of the page to see available rooms and today's rates. You can also call reception on +47 35 06 90 00.

**How much does a room cost?**
The price depends on dates, room type and package. You see all rates when you choose dates in the booking.

**Is breakfast included?**
It is shown in the rate you choose in the booking. Breakfast can also be bought at the hotel.

**How do I cancel or change my booking?**
Bookings made directly with us can be changed or cancelled until 2 pm the day before arrival. For some events, such as Christmas and New Year, the deadline is two weeks. A no-show is charged for the first night.

**When do I pay?**
On arrival. At check-in we take an authorisation on your card, so the amount is reserved until check-out. If you pay cash, we need a card as a guarantee.

**Which payment methods do you accept?**
Visa, Mastercard, Eurocard, Diners, JCB, BankAxept and Vipps. The hotel does not exchange currency, and cash withdrawals are not possible.

**Can I pay by invoice?**
Invoicing must be agreed before the stay, requires a credit check and applies to stays over NOK 5,000. We do not invoice private individuals.

**Do you sell gift cards?**
Yes. Gift cards can be used for an overnight stay with breakfast, dinner in the restaurant, an aperitif with storytelling, the Straand burger and pizza, and cabin or apartment stays.

**Can I stay if I am under 18?**
No, nobody under 18 can book or stay alone. Guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adult who is responsible during the stay.

### Arrival & departure
**When are check-in and check-out?**
Check-in from 3 pm, from 4 pm in June–September. Check-out before 11 am.

**Can I check in early?**
If your room is ready, you check in straight away. Otherwise you can use all the facilities, such as the pool and restaurant, until it is.

**Can I check out late?**
Yes, if we have capacity. Arrange it at reception the evening before at the latest. It costs NOK 100 per room per extra hour.

**Is reception open 24 hours?**
Yes, reception is open around the clock on +47 35 06 90 00.

**Is there parking, and what does it cost?**
Parking is free. The hotel's outdoor car park has approx. 100 spaces for cars and motorcycles, right next to the hotel.

**Can I charge my electric car?**
Yes. There are EV chargers at the hotel, both for hotel guests and Charge365 chargers paid in the app.

### Rooms
**What room types do you have?**
Historic rooms, standard doubles, family rooms, demi-suites, accessible rooms and singles: 125 rooms in total.

**What is in the rooms?**
All rooms have TV and wifi, and a bathroom with shower or bath, toilet and hairdryer. The demi-suites also have a coffee machine and a balcony.

**Do you have wheelchair-accessible rooms?**
We have two rooms with wide doors, a large bathroom and room for a wheelchair, and some family rooms can also be used. If you need a shower chair or raised toilet seat, let us know in good time.

**Do you have allergy-friendly rooms?**
Yes, the hotel has allergy rooms. Let us know when you book.

**Can I bring my dog or other pets?**
Yes, but tell us in advance, as only some rooms allow pets. The fee is NOK 300 per room per stay. Pets are not allowed in the shared areas, and you get your own entrance. Service and guide dogs are exempt.

**Is the hotel non-smoking?**
Straand is a non-smoking hotel. Smoking in the room is charged NOK 1,500, but there are outdoor areas where smoking is allowed.

**Do you have cabins or apartments?**
Yes, through Vrådal Booking we rent out cabins and holiday apartments in Vrådal for self-catering stays.

### Food & drink
**When are breakfast, lunch and dinner served?**
Breakfast from 8 am. Lunch 12–6 pm in the piano bar or on the terrace. Dinner has seatings between 7 and 9 pm, so tell us your preferred time.

**Can I eat at the hotel without staying?**
Yes, everyone is welcome. Call +47 35 06 90 00 to book a table.

**Do you cater for allergies and gluten-free diets?**
Yes. Several dishes can be served with gluten-free bread. Tell us about allergies when you book a table or on arrival.

**Do you serve afternoon tea?**
Yes, 12–5 pm in our historic lounges.

**When are the bar and terrace open?**
Fram Bar opens at noon, with the bar menu until 9 pm. The terrace opens at noon with food until 6 pm, weather permitting.

**When is the beach bar open?**
The beach bar on Lake Nisser is open approx. 23 June–20 August.

**What is "the taste of Telemark"?**
It is the kitchen's idea: local, seasonal produce from around us, such as game, berries and mushrooms in autumn.

### Facilities & wellness
**Is there a pool and sauna?**
Yes. The hotel has a heated indoor pool, open 7 am–7 pm. The saunas are open 7–9 am and 4–7 pm.

**Can day visitors use the pool?**
Yes, both day visitors and hotel guests can use the pool, the playground and the beach.

**Is there free wifi?**
Yes, free wifi throughout the hotel.

**Do you have a gym?**
Yes, the hotel has a fitness room.

### Families & children
**Is Straand good for families?**
Yes. We have family rooms, a playroom with Nintendo Wii and board games, and in summer a beach, trampolines and water activities at Straand Sommerland.

**What can children do when it rains?**
Swim in the indoor pool, play in the playroom or borrow toy boxes and board games.

**What is Straand Sommerland?**
Our own beach club on Lake Nisser, with a sandy beach, swimming, SUP, kayaks, canoes, pedal boats, trampolines, beach volleyball and kubb, and a beach bar with simple summer food.

### Activities & experiences
**What is MS Fram?**
The hotel's vintage boat from 1909. It sails on Lake Nisser and Vråvatn through the Småstraum and Storstraum locks, from mid-May to early October.

**Can we eat on board MS Fram?**
Coffee, drinks and snacks are served on board. Fresh baguettes or tapas platters can be pre-ordered.

**Can I hire a canoe, kayak or bike?**
Yes. Canoes, kayaks, bikes and e-bikes are hired at reception or at the Straand Sommerland bar. Life jackets are required by law, and you can hire one for NOK 50.

**Can I play golf nearby?**
Yes, on the 9-hole course on Fossøy, an island in Lake Nisser close to the hotel. The hotel rents out golf carts (the renter must be over 18).

**Where can we go hiking?**
Vrådal has marked routes for families and experienced hikers. Venelifjellet (905 m) has panoramic views, and Gaustatoppen makes a great day trip.

**Are you motorcycle friendly?**
Yes, Straand was Norway's first Bikers Welcome hotel and created HUBRiding: 15 routes with guaranteed bends, free parking, vehicle washing and gear drying.

**What is there to do in Vrådal in winter?**
Ski slopes, forest ski trails, fireside evenings, the pool and sauna, and play for the children.

### Meetings, celebrations & events
**Can we hold a meeting or conference with you?**
Yes. The Vrådal Hall is about 660 m² and seats 400 in one room. It can be divided, and there are several smaller rooms and breakout rooms.

**What equipment do the meeting rooms have?**
All meeting rooms have a PA system, screen and flip chart, and the breakout rooms have a screen and flip chart. Wifi throughout, and a 4.5-metre drive-in door straight into the hall.

**Can you arrange team building and activities?**
Yes, for example guided mountain hikes, canoe trips, trail biking, climbing, snowshoe and ski trips, ski instruction and team-building competitions.

**Can we have our wedding at Straand?**
Yes. A ceremony in the apple orchard, a party in historic rooms, a vintage car to the church and MS Fram for up to 90 guests.

**Do you host Christmas parties?**
Yes, on six weekends before Christmas, with home-made Christmas food in the historic lounges and a show. Rooms are booked separately from shows and events.

**What is the Straand Festival?**
The annual music and dance festival with Norwegian dance music on several stages, on the weekend of 30 October–1 November.

### Location & contact
**Where is the hotel?**
Kviteseidvegen 1698, 3853 Vrådal, at the northern end of Lake Nisser in West Telemark.

**How far is it from Oslo?**
Vrådal is in West Telemark, a natural stop between Oslo and Bergen. Kristiansand and Larvik are 2–3 hours away by car, Stavanger and Bergen 5–6 hours. Getting here has directions from Oslo.

**Can I get to the hotel by bus?**
Yes, the bus stop "Straand" is right next to the hotel. Check routes and times with Entur (entur.no).

**How do I contact you?**
Call +47 35 06 90 00 (reception is open 24 hours) or email straand@straand.no.

### History & sustainability
**How old is Straand Hotel?**
Straand became a coaching inn in 1864 and has been run by the same family for five generations. Today Katrine and Lars Arne Straand are the hosts.

**What is De Historiske?**
An association of historic hotels and restaurants in Norway. Straand Hotel is a member.

**What does the hotel do for the environment?**
Straand is Eco-Lighthouse certified, uses local produce, reduces food waste by serving plated meals most of the year, and takes part in making the region a sustainable destination.


## FAQ (norsk)
### Booking og priser
**Hvordan bestiller jeg rom?**
Velg datoer og antall gjester i bookingfeltet øverst på siden, så ser du ledige rom og dagens priser. Du kan også ringe resepsjonen på +47 35 06 90 00.

**Hva koster et rom?**
Prisen avhenger av datoer, romtype og pakke. Du ser alle priser når du velger datoer i bookingen.

**Er frokost inkludert?**
Det står i prisen du velger i bookingen. Frokost kan også kjøpes på hotellet.

**Hvordan avbestiller eller endrer jeg?**
Bestillinger gjort direkte hos oss kan endres eller avbestilles til kl. 14.00 dagen før ankomst. For enkelte arrangementer, som jul og nyttår, er fristen to uker. Ved no-show belastes første natt.

**Når betaler jeg?**
Ved ankomst. Ved innsjekk tar vi en autorisasjon på betalingskortet, slik at beløpet reserveres til utsjekk. Betaler du kontant, trenger vi et kort som garanti.

**Hvilke betalingsmåter tar dere?**
Visa, Mastercard, Eurocard, Diners, JCB, BankAxept og Vipps. Hotellet veksler ikke valuta, og det er ikke mulig å ta ut penger.

**Kan jeg få faktura?**
Faktura må avtales før oppholdet, krever kredittsjekk og gjelder opphold over 5 000 kr. Vi sender ikke faktura til privatpersoner.

**Selger dere gavekort?**
Ja. Gavekort kan brukes til overnatting med frokost, middag i restauranten, aperitiff med historiefortelling, Straandburger og -pizza, og hytte- eller leilighetsopphold.

**Kan jeg bo på hotellet hvis jeg er under 18 år?**
Nei, ingen under 18 år kan bestille eller bo alene. Gjester under 18 må ha med en myndig ledsager som er ansvarlig under oppholdet.

### Ankomst og avreise
**Når kan jeg sjekke inn og ut?**
Innsjekk fra kl. 15.00, i juni–september fra kl. 16.00. Utsjekk før kl. 11.00.

**Kan jeg sjekke inn tidligere?**
Er rommet klart, sjekker du inn med en gang. Ellers kan du bruke alle fasilitetene, som basseng og restaurant, til rommet er klart.

**Kan jeg få sen utsjekk?**
Ja, hvis vi har kapasitet. Avtal det i resepsjonen senest kvelden før. Det koster kr 100 per rom per ekstra time.

**Er resepsjonen åpen hele døgnet?**
Ja, resepsjonen er åpen hele døgnet på +47 35 06 90 00.

**Er det parkering, og hva koster det?**
Parkeringen er gratis. Hotellets utendørs parkering har ca. 100 plasser for bil og motorsykkel, rett ved hotellet.

**Kan jeg lade elbilen?**
Ja. Det er ladere for elbil ved hotellet, både for hotellets gjester og Charge365-ladere med betaling i appen.

### Rom og overnatting
**Hvilke romtyper har dere?**
Historiske rom, standard dobbeltrom, familierom, demi-suiter, tilgjengelige rom og enkeltrom, til sammen 125 rom.

**Hva har rommene?**
Alle rom har TV og trådløst nett, og bad med dusj eller badekar, wc og hårføner. Demi-suitene har også kaffemaskin og balkong.

**Har dere tilgjengelige rom for rullestolbrukere?**
Vi har to rom med brede dører, stort bad og plass til rullestol, og noen familierom kan også brukes. Trenger du dusjstol eller forhøyer på toalettet, si fra i god tid.

**Har dere allergirom?**
Ja, hotellet har allergirom. Si fra når du bestiller.

**Kan jeg ta med hund eller andre dyr?**
Ja, men si fra på forhånd, for det er et begrenset antall rom der dyr er tillatt. Tillegget er 300 kr per rom per opphold. Dyr kan ikke være i fellesområdene, og du får egen inngang. Servicehunder og førerhunder er unntatt.

**Er hotellet røykfritt?**
Straand er et røykfritt hotell. Røyking på rommet belastes med 1 500 kr, men det finnes uteområder der det er lov å røyke.

**Har dere hytter eller leiligheter?**
Ja, via Vrådal Booking leier vi ut hytter og ferieleiligheter i Vrådal for deg som vil ha selvhushold.

### Mat og drikke

Frokost fra kl. 08.00. Lunsj 12.00–18.00 i pianobaren eller på terrassen. Middag har bordsetninger 19.00–21.00, så gi oss gjerne beskjed om ønsket tid.

**Kan jeg spise hos dere uten å bo på hotellet?**
Ja, alle er velkomne. Ring +47 35 06 90 00 for å bestille bord.

**Tar dere hensyn til allergier og glutenfritt?**
Ja. Flere retter kan fås med glutenfritt brød. Si fra om allergier når du bestiller bord eller ved ankomst.

Ja, 12.00–17.00 i de stemningsfulle salongene.

Fram Bar er åpen fra kl. 12.00 med barmeny til kl. 21.00. Terrassen åpner kl. 12.00 med mat til kl. 18.00, med værforbehold.

Strandbaren ved Nisser er åpen ca. 23. juni–20. august.

**Hva er «Smaken av Telemark»?**
Det er kjøkkenets idé: lokale, sesongbaserte råvarer fra området rundt oss, som vilt, bær og sopp om høsten.

Vår egen beach club ved Nisser, med sandstrand, bading, SUP, kajakk, kano, pedalbåt, trampoliner, sandvolleyball og kubb, og en strandbar med enkel sommermat.

### Aktiviteter og opplevelser
**Hva er MS Fram?**
Hotellets veteranbåt fra 1909. Den seiler på Nisser og Vråvatn gjennom slusene Småstraum og Storstraum, fra midten av mai til begynnelsen av oktober.

Om bord serveres kaffe, noe godt i glasset og snacks. Ferske baguetter eller tapasfat kan forhåndsbestilles.

Ja. Kano, kajakk, sykkel og elsykkel leies i resepsjonen eller i baren på Straand Sommerland. Flytevest er påbudt, og du kan leie en for kr 50.

Ja, på den 9-hulls golfbanen på Fossøy, en øy i Nisser like ved hotellet. Hotellet leier ut golfbil (leietaker må være over 18).

**Hvor kan vi gå på tur?**
Vrådal har merkede ruter for både barnefamilier og erfarne. Venelifjellet (905 moh.) har panoramautsikt, og Gaustatoppen er en flott dagstur.

**Er dere et motorsykkelvennlig hotell?**
Ja, Straand var Norges første Bikers Welcome-hotell og står bak HUBRiding: 15 ruter med svinggaranti, gratis parkering, vask av kjøretøy og tørking av utstyr.

**Hva kan man gjøre i Vrådal om vinteren?**
Alpinbakke, skiløyper i skogen, peiskos, svømmebasseng med badstue og lek for barna.

### Møter, selskap og arrangementer
**Kan vi holde kurs eller konferanse hos dere?**
Ja. Vrådalsalen er på ca. 660 m² og tar 400 deltakere i én sal. Den kan deles opp, og vi har flere mindre saler og grupperom.

**Hvilket utstyr har møterommene?**
Alle møterom har forsterkeranlegg, lerret og flipover, og grupperommene har lerret og flipover. Trådløst nett i hele hotellet, og en kjøreport på 4,5 meter rett inn i salen.

**Kan dere arrangere teambuilding og aktiviteter?**
Ja, for eksempel fjelltur med guide, kanotur, stisykling, klatring, truger og skiturer, skiinstruksjon og teambuilding med konkurranser.

**Kan vi feire bryllup på Straand?**
Ja. Vielse i eplehagen, selskap i historiske lokaler, veteranbil til kirken og MS Fram for opptil 90 gjester.

**Arrangerer dere julebord?**
Ja, i seks helger før jul, med hjemmelaget julemat i de historiske stuene og show. Overnatting bestilles separat fra show og arrangementer.

**Hva er Straandfestivalen?**
Den årlige musikk- og dansefestivalen med norsk dansemusikk fra flere scener, i helgen 30. oktober–1. november.

### Beliggenhet og kontakt

Kviteseidvegen 1698, 3853 Vrådal, i nordenden av innsjøen Nisser i Vest-Telemark.

**Hvor langt er det fra Oslo?**
Vrådal ligger i Vest-Telemark, et naturlig stoppested mellom Oslo og Bergen. Fra Kristiansand og Larvik er det 2–3 timer med bil, fra Stavanger og Bergen 5–6 timer. Under Finn fram finner du veibeskrivelse fra Oslo.

### Historie og bærekraft
**Hvor gammelt er Straand Hotel?**
Straand ble skysstasjon i 1864 og har vært drevet av samme familie i fem generasjoner. I dag er Katrine og Lars Arne Straand vertskap.

**Hva er De Historiske?**
Et fellesskap av historiske hoteller og spisesteder i Norge. Straand Hotel er medlem.

**Hva gjør hotellet for miljøet?**
Straand er Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisert, bruker lokale råvarer, reduserer matsvinn ved å fase ut buffet store deler av året, og er med i arbeidet for å gjøre regionen til et bærekraftig reisemål.

## Blog: Motorists’ paradise: Why Telemark, Vrådal and Straand Hotel offer Norway’s coolest driving experiences (2026-09-04)
https://straand.no/en/blog/driving-holiday-in-telemark/

Here you can use the hotel as a base, leave your luggage in your room and spend your days exploring Telemark’s many winding roads.
### What are the Tivoli Roads in Telemark?
Among motor enthusiasts, several of Telemark’s winding and spectacular roads are known as the Tivoli Roads. The name describes quite well the feeling you get behind the wheel or handlebars. The roads wind through the mountain landscape, along lakes and through valleys, with bends, elevation differences and views that make the drive itself an experience. In the area around Vrådal you will find a large selection of roads and routes that are well suited for a car or motorcycle holiday in Telemark. You can, among other things, make the trip towards Dalen and Eidsborg, Fyresdal, Rauland or other parts of Telemark.
The great thing about having Vrådal as a starting point is that you can explore new roads every day and at the same time come back to the same hotel in the evening.
### Hubriding: One base, new driving experiences every day
Traditionally, a car or motorcycle holiday means that you pack in and out of your luggage every day and change hotels along the way. With Hubriding, the idea is different. Straand Hotel acts as the hub, or “hub”, for the driving experiences. You check in, unpack and leave your luggage in your room while you spend your days exploring Telemark.
### How Hubriding works
Straand Hotel is the base. Stay at the same hotel throughout your stay and have a fixed starting point for your trips. Choose between ready-made routes. You get access to a selection of quality-assured routes that are designed to give you good driving experiences in the area. Drive without luggage. When your luggage is left at the hotel, you get a freer and more comfortable driving experience. Come back to Straand. After the day’s drive, you can park, relax, enjoy a good meal and meet others who share the same interest in cars and motorcycles.
This is perhaps exactly what makes Hubriding in Telemark so attractive: You get the freedom of a road trip, but the comfort of having one fixed base.
### Straand Hotel: A natural stopover for motor enthusiasts
Straand Hotel has a long tradition as a meeting place for car and motorcycle enthusiasts. Here, a motor holiday is not only about the drive itself, but also about the community around it.
At the hotel you will find facilities that are adapted for guests arriving by car or motorcycle, including: Parking for cars and motorcycles. Possibility of washing vehicles. Facilities for drying driving equipment. Easy access to tools and equipment. Possibility of lunch and coffee for today’s trip. Social meeting places where you can share experiences and route tips with other motor enthusiasts. Here you can come back after the day’s drive, change your driving equipment and lower your shoulders.
### Road trip in Vrådal: Experience Telemark from the driver’s seat
Vrådal is a good starting point for those who want to experience Telemark by car. From here you can embark on day trips through mountains and valleys, along lakes and through small villages. You don’t necessarily need a specific destination. On a road trip in Telemark, the road itself is often a big part of the experience. Whether you drive a vintage car, sports car or a classic convertible, the area around Vrådal offers a varied road network and nature that makes it tempting to take “the little detour”.
### Motorcycle holiday in Vrådal: Turns, mountains and freedom
A motorcycle holiday in Vrådal can be filled with long day trips, short explorations or several days on winding mountain roads. With Straand Hotel as a base, you can choose a new route every morning and return to the hotel when the day’s drive is over. This makes it easy to combine driving experiences with good food, relaxation and social fellowship.
### Ready for your next drive?
Whether you come on a motorcycle, in a vintage car, a sports car or just love to experience Norway from the driver’s seat, Vrådal and Telemark have a lot to offer. With Straand Hotel as your base, you can explore the Tivoli roads and the rest of Telemark on day trips, without having to pack your car or motorcycle every morning. Unpack once. Choose a new route every day. And let the road be part of the experience.
Roll in, unpack and enjoy the road!

## Blog: Autumn in Vrådal: 10 fantastic things you can do on your autumn holiday with Straand Hotel as a base (2026-09-04)
https://straand.no/en/blog/autumn-in-vradal-10-things/

When the heat of summer lets go in Telemark, Vrådal transforms into a living painting in fiery red, golden and deep orange colours. Autumn is one of the most beautiful and peaceful times to visit the Norwegian mountains. The fresh, clear mountain air, mirror-like lakes and forest floor filled with berries make the area a perfect destination for both couples on a weekend trip and families on autumn holiday.
In the heart of Vrådal is the historic Straand Hotel, which since 1864 has welcomed travellers on the shores of Nisser. With its unique location, historic soul and modern facilities, the hotel is a natural starting point for experiences in the area. Today, the hotel is run by the fifth generation of the Straand family.
Here are 10 things you can experience in Vrådal in the autumn, whether you are looking for outdoor adventures, family time or pure relaxation.
### 1. Climb Venelifjellet – panoramic views in crackling autumn colours
One of Telemark’s popular and beautiful mountain hikes is the hike to Venelifjellet (905 masl). The name means “the beautiful mountain”, and the view from the top really lives up to the name. The hike starts over wooden bridges through marshy areas and continues along well-marked paths towards the top. In autumn, the view of the golden mountain landscape and Lake Nisser is very special. The hike is suitable for both adults and children.
### 2. Classic indoor coziness in front of the fireplace at Straand Hotel
After an active day out in the autumn air, there is nothing that beats real indoor coziness at the hotel. At Straand Hotel, you can sink into a comfortable armchair in the historic living rooms, feel the warmth of the fireplace and enjoy a good book, a cup of hot chocolate or a hot cup of tea. Here you will have time to lower your shoulders and enjoy the warm and personal atmosphere that hosts Katrine and Lars Arne Straand are so keen to preserve.
### 3. Lock cruise with the veteran boat M/S Fram
Experience Vrådal’s beautiful inland archipelago from the water on board M/S Fram from 1909. The boat departs from the pier close to Straand Hotel and sails on Nisser and Vråvatn. The trip takes you calmly through narrow straits, past bare rocks and autumn-coloured mountainsides. One of the highlights is the passage of Småstraum lock, Northern Europe’s highest hand-operated lock system. An atmospheric experience for both young and old.
### 4. Pure well-being: Indoor pool and warm sauna
When the autumn cold creeps in, it’s good to be able to pull indoors. At Straand Hotel, you can take a refreshing swim in the heated indoor pool, before warming up in the sauna. It’s a perfect way to relax after a day of hiking, cycling or other experiences in nature.
### 5. On a berry and mushroom trip in the forest
Autumn is high season for nature’s own pantry. In the forests and mountain areas around Vrådal, you will find, among other things, blueberries, lingonberries and various types of mushrooms. Take your family or partner for a leisurely walk in the forest and see what you find. Berries, mushrooms and nature are among the easiest, but also most enjoyable activities you can do on an autumn holiday in Norway. Remember to make sure you know the species before eating mushrooms or other plants you find in nature.
### 6. Play and activities for children at Straand Sommerland
If you are travelling on an autumn holiday with children, there are still good opportunities for play and activity around Straand. On the shores of Nisser is Straand Sommerland, with a playground, trampolines, climbing tower and sandy beach. The areas around the hotel also offer great hiking opportunities and space for play and exploration. And should the autumn weather show its wet side, it is extra good to have the hotel’s indoor facilities to draw in to.
### 7. Taste Telemark’s autumn: Game and local ingredients
An autumn holiday in Vrådal is also about good taste experiences. At Straand Hotel, local ingredients and Norwegian traditions are central, and autumn is a particularly nice time to enjoy the season’s flavors. Game, mushrooms, berries and other local ingredients are perfect for the season. A good meal in the hotel’s restaurant is a natural end to a day filled with experiences in the mountains and nature.
### 8. Golf in the autumn colours on Fossøy
Do you love golf? Then you should head to Vrådal Golf Club and the beautiful 9-hole course on Fossøy. The golf course is located on an island in the middle of Nisser, surrounded by water and mountains. In the autumn, you get to play in your very own frame, with sparkling autumn colours around you. The course is open as long as the weather and course conditions allow.
### 9. Experience the mountains from the bike seat
Vrådal is a great starting point for bike rides, and autumn gives nature a very special atmosphere. Straand Hotel is known for its Hubriding concept, where the hotel serves as a base for day trips on two wheels. Whether you prefer electric bikes, gravel roads or longer bike rides through forests and mountains, there are opportunities for different levels. With the autumn colours as a backdrop, the bike ride itself becomes part of the experience.
### 10. The perfect autumn weekend with peace, quality time and cosiness
Sometimes the best thing about a weekend or autumn holiday is simply to completely relax. In Vrådal, you don’t need a packed program. Start the day with fresh mountain air and a leisurely walk, enjoy a good meal, take a swim or warm up in the sauna and end the day in front of the fireplace. Vrådal’s combination of magnificent nature, historic surroundings and good facilities makes it easy to find peace and recharge your batteries.
### Plan your autumn holiday in Vrådal
Whether you dream of fresh mountain hikes, quality time with the family or indoor coziness at the hotel in front of the fireplace, an autumn holiday in Vrådal has a lot to offer. With its historic charm, good dining experiences and many facilities, Straand Hotel is a natural starting point for autumn experiences in Vrådal and Telemark. Pack your warm sweater, lace up your hiking boots and get ready to experience Vrådal from perhaps its most beautiful side.

## Blog: The 5 most beautiful sights in and around Vrådal (2026-08-31)
https://straand.no/en/blog/the-5-most-beautiful-sights/

Vrådal is a place where nature is allowed to be the main attraction. Here you will find beautiful lakes, mountains, forests and viewpoints that make it easy to stop and just enjoy the surroundings. Whetheryou visit Vrådal in the summer, autumn, winter or spring, there are many places that are worth experiencing. Here are five of our favourites in and around Vrådal.
### 1. Nisser – Vrådal’s beautiful lake
In the middle of Vrådal lies Lake Nisser, which stretches between the mountains and gives the area much of its character. Here you can enjoy a quiet day by the water, take a walk along the shore or experience the lake from the sea. In the summer, it is also possible to swim and try activities such as kayaking, canoeing and SUP. A trip on the veteran boat M/S Fram is a great way to experience Nisser. The historic boat has sailed on the lake for generations and gives you the opportunity to see Vrådal from a slightly different side.
### 2. Vrådal Panorama and the view from the mountains
If you want to experience Vrådal from above, Vrådal Panorama is a natural place to take the trip. Here you will meet mountains, forests and open landscapes with great views of Vrådal and the lakes. In the summer, the area is a good starting point for mountain hikes, while winter offers skiing and beautiful winter landscapes. There is something special about getting up in the heights and seeing how the mountains and lakes lie like a large landscape below you.
### 3. Venelifjellet – mountain hike with a view
For those who like to go hiking, Venelifjellet is one of the great nature experiences in the area around Vrådal. The trip offers varied terrain and beautiful viewpoints along the way. At the top, you get a fantastic reward for the trip with a view of the mountains and lakes in Telemark. Venelifjellet is well suited for those who want a nature experience without it having to be a full day trip. Remember good shoes and clothes according to the weather. The mountain weather can change quickly, even on nice summer days.
### 4. Kviteseid old church and the cultural history in the area
Vrådal is not just about nature. The area around Vrådal also has an exciting history and many cultural monuments. Kviteseid old church is one of the sights that is worth seeing. The medieval stone church is beautifully situated by Lake Kviteseidvatnet and is surrounded by a historic cultural landscape. A trip here provides a nice combination of nature, architecture and history, and is suitable when you want to experience a little more than just mountains and lakes.
### 5. Gaustatoppen – a spectacular day trip from Vrådal
If you have a little extra time, a trip to Gaustatoppen can be a highlight of your holiday. Gaustatoppen is one of Norway’s most famous mountains and offers spectacular views of large parts of southern Norway. On clear days, you can see very far beyond Telemark’s mountain landscape. For those who want a different way to the top, the Gaustabanen cable car goes inside the mountain and takes you up to the top. It is a longer excursion from Vrådal, but definitely worth considering if you want to combine your stay with one of Telemark’s great nature experiences.
### Experience Vrådal at your own pace
One of the nicest things about Vrådal is that you don’t have to fill your days with activities to have a good time. Here, a mountain hike, a boat trip on Nisser or a quiet moment with a view of the water can be the experience itself. Vrådal is surrounded by nature that invites both small and large adventures, regardless of the season. And when the day’s experiences are over, it’s good to come back to a place where you can lower your shoulders, enjoy a good meal and let the impressions sink in.

## Blog: What can you do in Vrådal with children? A guide to family holidays in Telemark. (2026-08-31)
https://straand.no/en/blog/vradal-with-children/

Vrådal is a fantastic starting point for a family holiday in Telemark. Here you will find mountains, forests and lakes, combined with activities for both young and old children. But what can you really do in Vrådal with children? Here are some of our favorites.
### Straand Sommerland and Nisser
On hot summer days, Nisser is a natural gathering point. At Straand Sommerland you can swim, relax on the beach or try SUP, kayak, canoe, rowing boat and pedal boat. You can also play beach volleyball and kubb, or just enjoy a quiet day by the water.
### Experience Vrådal from the water
Take a trip on the historic veteran boat MS Fram, built in 1909. The boat sails on Nisser and Vråvatn and gives both young and old a different way to experience Telemark’s beautiful landscape. Here, the journey itself becomes part of the experience.
### Out for a walk in nature
Around Vrådal you will find beautiful nature that invites you to both short and longer trips. With children, the trip does not have to have a big goal. A small forest path, a viewpoint or a break by the water can be more than enough. Let the children explore at their own pace, and remember that the best trips are not always the longest.
### Golf for the whole family
For families with older children, Vrådal Golf Course can be a pleasant activity. Here you can combine golf with fresh air and beautiful nature, and maybe there will be a small family competition along the way.
### What can you do in Vrådal when it rains?
The weather in Telemark can change, but a rainy day does not have to ruin your holiday. At Straand Hotel you can enjoy a quiet breakfast, good food and pleasant times together. Take a dip in the indoor pool, let the children romp around in the play areas or gather around the fireplace in one of our pleasant common areas. Sometimes it is also nice to have a day without a packed program. .
### Vrådal with small and large children
Vrådal is well suited for families because the activities can be adapted to age and energy. With small children, beach life, swimming, short walks and quiet excursions can be perfect. With older children, you can try water activities, golf, cycling, longer trips or a trip with MS Fram. The most important thing is to have time for both experiences and breaks.
### Where should you stay with children in Vrådal?
At Straand Hotel you stay in the middle of the experiences, with nature and many of the activities in Vrådal close by. Here the family can combine active days with good meals, pleasant surroundings and time to just be together. For us, a family holiday is not about achieving as much as possible, but about creating good memories together.
### Our tips for family holidays
Plan a little, but not everything. Leave room for spontaneous experiences.
Bring swimwear. Lake Nisser is hard to resist on hot summer days.
Pack for the weather. Good shoes and clothes for both sun and rain make the holiday easier.
Remember the breaks. A good holiday also needs time to do nothing.
### Family holiday in Vrådal
The great thing about Vrådal is that you can fill your days exactly as you wish. With beach life, mountains, forests, boating, activities and good meals, there is something for the whole family. And maybe it’s precisely the small moments that you remember best when the holiday is over. The first swim in Nisser, the ice cream on the beach or the laughter around the dinner table. There is room for all this at Straand.
